function: Phase-Net CNN infers IRS phase shifts inside alternating optimization that minimizes total uplink RF power under secrecy outage constraints, replacing SDR and manifold solvers (p. 8-9).
system: Uplink: BS with 8 antennas, 4 single-antenna users, passive reflecting IRS with 24 elements, 2-antenna eavesdropper, 2 GHz carrier (p. 3, 10).
method: Phase-Net: three convolutional plus three fully connected layers; unsupervised training (no labels) with loss equal to negative sum of secrecy variables z_k (p. 9-10).
data_channel: Custom simulator: 3x10^5 training and 3x10^4 validation CSI samples from Rayleigh fading with log-normal shadowing path loss at 2 GHz; 1000 test samples (p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained on Rayleigh samples, users 40-80 m from BS; tested on 1000 independent samples, sweeping Ns, Nt, Ne, K, threshold and rate for all schemes (p. 10-12).
baselines: Without IRS (MRC), random phase shift, AO-SDR, AO-Man (all non-learned); no earlier learned method compared (p. 10).
metrics: Average user RF power versus Ns, Nt, Ne, K, outage threshold and coding rate; failed-user proportion and SOP; convergence (p. 10-13).
complexity: none for Phase-Net; orders given only for the non-learned AO-SDR and AO-Man (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 10: "CSI samples are generated based on the Rayleigh channel model"; Rayleigh fading with log-normal shadowing path loss is a custom simulator, with no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "The test data consists of 1000 samples independently"; no unseen scenario is stated for a trained Phase-Net, and its layers scale with K and Ns (p. 9), so the sweeps of Figs. 4-9 imply separate networks.
q3_support: p. 10: "Phase inference is performed using the DL-based scheme proposed in Section IV"; the other four schemes (without IRS, random phase, AO-SDR, AO-Man) are non-learned, so no earlier learned baseline is compared.
q4_support: p. 8: orders are derived only for "the overall complexity of the RF power minimization algorithm using manifold optimization is approximately" and for SDR; Phase-Net has only the qualitative claim to reduce complexity, with no parameters, FLOPs or runtime.
q5_support: p. 10: "CSI samples are generated based on the Rayleigh channel model"; the data are self-generated, and no code or data link or DOI appears (only Python, PyTorch, Matlab, CVX and Manopt are named).
notes: Area 3: the learned part is Phase-Net, which replaces the SDR or manifold step that sets the IRS phase shifts; RF power and receive beamformer updates stay closed-form and non-learned (p. 8-9). The abstract claim that DL substantially reduces time complexity is not backed by a reported runtime or operation count. Fig. 5 uses Ns = 32 while the default is Ns = 24 (p. 10-11), and the paper does not say whether Phase-Net is retrained per configuration. The earlier conference paper [16] is cited for the SDR method (p. 2) and is not a learned baseline.
